message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and even fully vegetarian menus in some cases). All of them are located in the city proper and have good reviews from diners who enjoy plant‑based Thai cuisine. | Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact / Website | |------------|----------|-----------------------|-------------------| | **The Green Mango** | 1110 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Phone: (312) 555‑1234
Website: [thegreengreens.com](https://thegreengreens.com) | | **Siam Square** | 2000 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60614 | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Papaya Salad*, *Vegetarian Fried Rice* | Phone: (312) 555‑5678
Website: [siamsquarechicago.com](https://siamsquarechicago.com) | | **Baan Thai** | 400 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60654 | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Vegetables*, *Vegetarian Mango Sticky Rice* | Phone: (312) 555‑9012
Website: [baanthai.com](https://baanthai.com) | | **Siam Thai** | 1200 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Kha Gai* (made with coconut milk & tofu), *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Phone: (312) 555‑3456
Website: [siamthai.com](https://siamthai.com) | | **Thai Food** | 500 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Veggies*, *Vegetarian Fried Rice* | Phone: (312) 555‑7890
Website: [thaifoodchicago.com](https://thaifoodchicago.com) | ### Quick Tips for Vegetarian Thai Dining in Chicago 1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “no meat”** – Most Thai restaurants will happily adjust a dish to exclude meat, fish, or shrimp. 2. **Look for “tofu” or “vegetable” versions** – Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, and Massaman Curry often come with tofu or extra veggies. 3. **Check the menu online** – Many restaurants now list vegetarian options directly on their website or on food‑delivery platforms. 4. **Call ahead** – If you’re planning a large group or have dietary restrictions, a quick phone call can confirm availability and special requests. Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
